scenarios.name: threshold-adds-five
scenarios.why: Seven cards in the graveyard while it resolves: add {B}{B}{B}{B}{B} instead of {B}{B}{B}. The {1}{B} cost was paid from the pool first, so exactly five black remain.

scenarios.name: six-in-graveyard-adds-three
scenarios.why: Cabal Ritual is on the stack, not in the graveyard, while it resolves; six other cards is below threshold, so it adds exactly {B}{B}{B}.
